senses.gloss: (enlargement of פָּרַס) to spread, divulge, publish; to uncover, expose.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 9a:3-4">Sot. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>היא עשתה … פִּירְסְמָהּ בגלוי</he> she acted in secret, the Lord exposes her in public.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:1:10">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵇ</cite> top <he>רבי היה מְפַרְסֵם עצמו וכ׳</he> Rabbi used to make himself conspicuous (act ostentatiously) on two days in the year (as a protest against certain ritual restrictions).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21">Num. R. s. 21</cite> <he>כשם שהקב״ה … לפַרְסְמָן וכ׳</he> as the Lord busies himself with the praise of the righteous in order to make them known in the world, so &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21">Ib.</cite> <he>פנחס פִּירְסְמוֹ לשבח וכ׳</he> he published Phineas for praise, and Zimri for blame.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21">Ib.</cite> <he>ופי׳ את בתו בקלון</he> and exposed his daughter for prostitution. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 16 <he>מה כלה … ואינה מְפַרְסֶמֶת עצמה וכ׳</he> as the bride is retired in her father’s house and does not unveil herself (show herself in public) until she is about to enter the bridal chamber …: so must a scholar be retired, and be revealed (renowned) by his good deeds; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41">Ex. R. s. 41</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּרְסָם</he>; f. <he>מְפוּרְסֶמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְפוּרְסָמִים</he>, <he>מְפוּרְסָמִין</he>; <he>מְפוּרְסָמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:7">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>בזמן שאינו מפ׳</he> when he is not generally known (as a bastard).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 391">Yalk. Ex. 391</cite> <he>מפ׳ במעשיו … שהיא מפ׳</he> well-known by his deeds, as the bride is unveiled (on her wedding day), v. supra; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> <he>יצא חם</he> … <he>וכלב מפ׳ בתשמישו</he> Ham came out of the ark black, and the dog disgraced by the mean way of his copulation; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6:10">Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵈ</cite> <he>מְפוּרְצָם</he> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:15">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>כלב נקשר</he>).

senses.gloss: to be published, made known, exposed. Lev. R. l. c. (ref. to Lev. VI, 18) במקום … כדי שלא יִתְפַּרְסְמוּ החטאים ‘in the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed’, … in order that the sinners be not exposed to shame.
units: <cite ref="Leviticus 6:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אבל אם נ׳</he> but if he is known (as a bastard); a. e.
